title: The unknowns of Taç Mahal - Let's Travel Together
description: Those who went to India have always seen and saw either cows, Buddhists or temples. However, the four corners of that huge state were full of the works of Muslim Turks who ruled India for 7 centuries for a thousand years. Although the British try to swallow these wonderful works and their banas as muğal, we know the facts very well and we want to announce. ----------------------------------------------------- Talha Uğurluel  Http://www.talhaugurluel.com/magaza for your book orders  My social media accounts:   Twitter: https://twitter.com/talhaugurluel  Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/talhaugurluell  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/talhaugurluelofficial  Web http://www.talhaugurluel.com
